_about: Corpus ID registry. Every story needs one entry. story_id is the permanent corpus ID used in chunk IDs, story_prompt:<id> / model_story:<id>, lib/retellings.ts and Story.storyId in the app -- never rename one. title must match the model stories doc ('Story N: <title>') and raw/story_scenes.md. match: words that identify the story in a samples doc's file name (e.g. '孟母 samples with Teacher feedback.docx'). sample_id_prefix (optional, only for the original two docs): keeps their older sample IDs (mengmu_samples#7) so chunk IDs already logged in Story.scenes[].feedbackChunkIds stay valid; new stories omit it and use <story_id>#<N>. Order matters: samples are ordered by this list, and each rule_card/ai_error_card shows the first examples in that order -- add new stories at the end.
